source: https://www.babelstreet.com/ (inline header <svg aria-label="Babel Street">, viewBox 0 0 576 162, drawn in .st0 {fill:#fff})
edits: removed the HTML class attribute from the root <svg>
kept the square-spiral mark (elements 11-13: two polygons and the centre square), dropped the 'BABEL STREET' letters (elements 0-10)
cropped the viewBox to the mark
light file: #FFFFFF → #00203F on the mark (the site's own --background navy, which is also the navy of Babel Street's favicons), since the white header mark vanishes on the light tile
dark file keeps the header's own white (#FFFFFF), unrecoloured
notes: Rosette has no mark of its own any more; this is Babel Street's mark. The only vector Babel Street serves is the white header logo, so the light-theme navy is a recolour to the site's own navy (the favicon colour), not a published navy file.
license: Babel Street (Rosette Text Analytics) brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Babel Street (Rosette Text Analytics).
